$comment: Which workspace packages are entry points, and which are knowingly reachable from none. Enforced by @dasher/repo-graph; see packages/repo-graph/src/reachability.ts for why this is a declaration rather than a rule against orphans. Adding an entry here should be a reviewed diff, not a quiet accumulation.

unreachable.name: @dasher/control-plane
unreachable.reason: The multi-tenant schema and its migrator. Deliberately not wired to the product yet: no sign-in path exists, and ADR-003 gates the control plane on real customer data rather than on the planner or the UI. Step 5 of the restructure proposal is the persistence slice that gives it its first importer.

unreachable.name: @dasher/calculation-engine
unreachable.reason: Its only importer was the integration test cross-checking the PL/pgSQL evaluator that the baseline squash deleted. Wiring it into @dasher/planner is step 4 of the restructure proposal and is the next visible change.
